items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Alfonso Trent? Yeah. It's a good band everybody says. I never got a chance to hear it. [INTERVIEWEE] It was a good one.

ctx.x: Yes, we did. Harry James is from Texas, and Ray McKinley is from Texas, and, uh, Jimmy Joy, of course. Jimmy Maloney played wonderful clarinet. He's from Texas. It turned out some very good boys over there. Oh, we sure did.
Alfonso Trent? Yeah. It's a good band everybody says. I never got a chance to hear it.
